title.narrative: Supporting Implementation of National Forest Inventory and Monitoring

description.narrative:
The Enhanced National Forest Monitoring for Climate Action in Indonesia Project is FAO's implemented project to support the Government of Indonesia in implementing the newly designed national forest inventory and improving its national forest monitornig system.
The outcome of the project is large-scale forest monitoring capacities upgraded and modernized in government institutions to comprehensively respond to national, regional, and global needs, support NDC implementation, and provide the transparency, credibility of forest data required to support low carbon and sustainable development.
The project will provide technical assistance in three main areas of support: 1. National Forest Inventory (overall technical guidance and programmatic support) 2. National Forest Inventory (operational implementation, including data collection and training) 3. Advancing land monitoring through the NFMS (SIMONTANA)
The main partner is the Ministry of Forestry (MoF), particularly Directorate General of Forestry Planning (PKTL), IPSDH (Inventarisasi dan Pemantauan Sumberdaya Hutan – or Office for inventory and monitoring of forest resources) and its BPKHTL units. However, the project will involve Provincial Environment and Forestry Offices (DLHK, Dinas Lingkungan Hidup dan Kehutanan), Forest Management Units (KPHs), national and provincial universities, technical agencies (BIG), and other government institutions in its implementation.
